hard_invariants.description: HMAC-SHA-256 chain on execution ledger; broken chain halts all ops
No wall-clock injection; all timestamps via _utc_iso()
Only ACCEPTED dispositions execute; non-ACCEPTED rejected fail-closed
Execution ledger is append-only; no record mutation permitted
Amendment application + ledger append are atomic; partial writes raise
CAE reads RDP disposition only; never writes to RDP/CAL/CFI ledgers
Every amendment execution emits a signed JSONL audit record
Post-execution constitutional snapshot written after every successful cycle
CAE cannot amend its own invariants; self-referential amendments rejected
execution_id must be globally unique; duplicates rejected fail-closed
